description: ERC20 token metadata on Base. Name, symbol, decimals, total supply and bytecode presence for a token contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","address":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","name":"USD Coin","symbol":"USDC","decimals":6,"totalSupply":"…","isContract":true}. Price: $0.0032 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: base_token_info
